ayahs.tr: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.
And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
ayahs.tl: Wa maa adraaka ma lailatul qadr

ayahs.ar: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ
ayahs.tr: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
ayahs.tl: Lailatul qadri khairum min alfee shahr

ayahs.ar: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ
ayahs.tr: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
ayahs.tl: Tanaz zalul malaa-ikatu war roohu feeha bi izni-rab bihim min kulli amr

ayahs.tr: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
ayahs.tl: Salaamun hiya hattaa mat la'il fajr
